explain.ja: 図1-1のような囲いを穴熊囲い、または単に「穴熊」と言います。香車の下に玉が潜り込むのが特徴で、盤の隅に玉を置く囲いは総称して穴熊と呼ばれます。とにかく堅いのが特徴です。
explain.en: The castle in Figure 1-1 is called the Anaguma (bear-in-the-hole) castle. Its feature is the king tucked under the lance, and castles that place the king in a corner are generally called Anaguma. Their trait is sheer solidity.

section.ja: 穴熊囲いの基本形、香車の下に潜り込む
section.en: Basic form of the Anaguma castle: tuck the king under the lance

title.ja: 図1-2 まずは玉を奥に
title.en: Figure 1-2: First move the king deeper

explain.ja: 穴熊囲いを組むには、まず角を1マス前に出し、玉を奥に持っていきます。
explain.en: To build Anaguma, first move the bishop forward one square, then take the king inward.

section.ja: 穴熊の組み方は?手数がかかるのが欠点
section.en: How to build Anaguma? The drawback is the number of moves

title.ja: 図1-3 玉を隅っこに移動させて完成
title.en: Figure 1-3: Move the king to the corner to complete it

explain.ja: さらに玉を隅に移動し、銀で蓋をすれば穴熊の完成です。ここからさらに金や銀をくっつけて堅くしていきます。
explain.en: Move the king into the corner and cap it with a silver to complete the Anaguma. From there attach more gold and silver to make it firmer.

section.ja: 穴熊の組み方は?手数がかかるのが欠点
section.en: How to build Anaguma? The drawback is the number of moves

title.ja: 図1-4 最もよく使われる形
title.en: Figure 1-4: The most commonly used form

explain.ja: 穴熊の基本形に金を2枚くっつけた形が最もスタンダードな穴熊で、簡単には寄らない形になりますが、組むのにかなり手数がかかります。穴熊は終盤の寄せ合いで強さを発揮し、囲いが崩されても持ち駒の金や銀をくっつけて再生できるのも強みです。一方、攻められると玉の逃げ道がなく詰みやすいのが弱点で、守りが堅い分攻めが細くなり、攻め手を封じられてじわじわ崩される「穴熊の姿焼き」になりがちです。穴熊の弱点と崩し方のパターンを知っておけば、終盤で一歩リードできるかもしれません。
explain.en: The basic Anaguma plus two golds is the most standard Anaguma. It is hard to mate but takes many moves to build. Anaguma shows its strength in endgame races, and even if broken it can be rebuilt by attaching golds and silvers from hand. Its weakness is that once attacked the king has no escape and is easily mated; being so solid, its attack tends to be thin, and when the attack is completely sealed it is slowly dismantled, a situation called "grilled Anaguma". Knowing its weaknesses and the patterns for breaking it can give you an edge in the endgame.

section.ja: 穴熊の組み方は?手数がかかるのが欠点
section.en: How to build Anaguma? The drawback is the number of moves

explain.ja: 最も基本的な穴熊が「居飛車穴熊」で、単に穴熊と言えばこの囲いを指すことが多いです。対振り飛車で使われ、美濃囲いより堅さで勝りますが、角頭を狙う攻めには若干弱いです。
explain.en: The most basic Anaguma is Static Rook Anaguma, and "Anaguma" alone usually means this. Used against Ranging Rook, it is firmer than Mino but slightly weak to attacks aimed at the bishop's head.

explain.ja: 居飛車穴熊の弱点である角頭をカバーしているのが「松尾流穴熊」です。右金を6七、左金を7八にくっつける点が通常の居飛車穴熊の駒組みと異なります。戦いの中で攻めの銀を7九までくっつけられれば、相当な堅さになります。
explain.en: Matsuo-style Anaguma covers the bishop's head, the weakness of Static Rook Anaguma. It differs in attaching the right gold to 6七 and the left gold to 7八. If the attacking silver can be attached to 7九 during the fight, it becomes very solid.

explain.ja: 金銀4枚で囲う最強の穴熊が「ビッグ4」です。ここまで組めればそれだけで優勢ですが、実戦ではなかなかそこまで組ませてもらえません。
explain.en: The strongest Anaguma, surrounded by four gold/silver pieces, is "Big 4". If it can be built you are already better, but in real games the opponent rarely lets you.

explain.ja: 左美濃囲いを発展させて組むのが「銀冠穴熊」です。通常の居飛車穴熊と比べて、隙を少なく組めることや、角道を開けたままでも組みやすいことが利点です。
explain.en: Ginkanmuri Anaguma is built by developing Left Mino. Compared with the ordinary Static Rook Anaguma, its advantages are fewer weaknesses and ease of building even with the bishop's diagonal open.

explain.ja: 矢倉囲いから発展させて組むのが「矢倉穴熊」です。通常の居飛車穴熊は対振り飛車戦で多く使われますが、この囲いは基本的に相居飛車で用います。
explain.en: Yagura Anaguma is developed from a Yagura castle. Ordinary Static Rook Anaguma is mostly used against Ranging Rook, but this castle is basically used in double Static Rook.

explain.ja: 右側に穴熊を作るのが「振り飛車穴熊」で、名前のとおり振り飛車で使われます。ここから袖飛車に振り直して3筋から攻める順もあるのが特徴です。
explain.en: Ranging Rook Anaguma builds the Anaguma on the right side and, as named, is used in Ranging Rook. A feature is the line of re-swinging the rook to a sleeve-rook position and attacking from the 3rd file.

title.ja: 図2-7 ミレニアム囲い

explain.ja: 香車の下ではなく桂馬の下に潜るのが「ミレニアム囲い」で、2000年頃に藤井システムの対策としてよく使われたことからこの名が付きました。通常の穴熊より堅さでは劣りますが、相手の角のラインから玉を外しているのがポイントで、別名「トーチカ」とも呼ばれます。
explain.en: The Millennium castle burrows under the knight rather than the lance. It got its name because it was often used around 2000 as a countermeasure to the Fujii System. It is less solid than the ordinary Anaguma, but its point is that the king is off the opponent's bishop line; it is also called "tochka".

section.ja: ミレニアム囲い(トーチカ)

explain.ja: 居飛車穴熊の香車と玉の位置を逆転させたのが「串カツ囲い」で、香車の上にある玉を串にささったカツに例えています。ミレニアム囲いと同様に玉を相手の角の利きから外すのが狙いですが、端攻めに弱く、実戦ではあまり使われません。
explain.en: The Kushikatsu castle swaps the positions of the lance and king in Static Rook Anaguma; the king sitting on the lance is likened to a cutlet on a skewer. Like the Millennium castle, it aims to take the king off the opponent's bishop line, but it is weak to edge attacks and rarely used in real games.

section.ja: 串カツ囲い(端美濃囲い)
